settings.heading: How many modes do the knob lights have?
settings.text:
There are two modes: Temperature-Responsive Lighting and Rainbow Lighting.

  • Tap the light button once to enter the Temperature-Responsive mode. When the knob is turned on, its color changes according to the grill's internal temperature.
  • Tap the button a second time to enter the Rainbow mode, where a single color cycles through.
  • Tap the button a third time for Multi-Color Rainbow mode, where over 10 colors cycle dynamically.

settings.heading: How many colors does the Temperature-Responsive Lighting have?
settings.text:
• Blue: <200°F
  • Cyan: 200–300°F
  • Green: 300–400°F
  • Yellow: 400–500°F
  • Orange: 500–600°F (Optimal for grilling)
  • Red: >600°F

settings.heading: Can the rear burner’s heat level be adjusted?
settings.text: No, the red knob for the rear burner only allows turning it on and off, without heat adjustment. This design optimizes rotisserie grilling performance.

settings.heading: How are the knob lights and display powered on the Eminence 605?
settings.text: The Eminence 605 includes a power adapter that must be plugged in for operation.

settings.heading: Can the Eminence 605 be converted to natural gas?
settings.text: Yes, but a natural gas conversion kit is required.

settings.heading: Where can I check my propane tank level?
settings.text: You can check the propane level directly on the grill’s display screen.

settings.heading: Is the rear panel fully enclosed?
settings.text: Yes, the rear panel is fully enclosed. However, it can be easily opened to access and remove the grease tray before securely closing again.

settings.heading: Is the entire grill equipped with infrared sear burner?
settings.text: Yes, the infrared sear burner ensures even heating and faster temperature rise.

settings.heading: Does my grill require assembly?
settings.text:
Yes. MG products require assembly. We provide instructional videos and digital manuals on our website

Learn More

settings.heading: Will accessories and the grill arrive together if I order a bundle?
settings.text: No, the grill and accessories are shipped separately and may arrive at different times.
